sources.access_blocker: client-fingerprint denial: JS proof-of-work challenge (curl fingerprint) or fabricated 404 (python-urllib fingerprint) for every URL including the homepage
sources.identity: stooq.com free daily historical CSV export endpoint (https://stooq.com/q/d/l/?s=<sym>&d1=YYYYMMDD&d2=YYYYMMDD&i=d)
sources.rationale: No terms text could be captured in-session, so the zero-cost/license test (PLAN 4.1 items 2-3) cannot be passed. Every programmatic request from this lane - homepage, CSV export and both guessed terms URLs - was denied to non-browser clients: curl-like clients receive an HTTP 200 JavaScript SHA-256 proof-of-work 'verify your browser' challenge page (796 bytes, digest recorded); python-urllib clients receive a fabricated HTTP 404 page (271 bytes, identical body for every URL including the homepage). The lane does not bypass anti-bot verification, so no data and no terms were obtainable without a real browser session.

sources.identity: State Street Global Advisors (SSGA, now State Street Investment Management) official SPDR ETF fund-data library: NAV history, premium/discount history and the SPDR ETF historical distributions workbook
sources.rationale: Zero-cost ACCESS is proven: issuer fund-data XLSX files downloaded directly over HTTPS with no account, no credentials and no payment (digests recorded), and the issuer fund page is the authoritative identity/inception evidence. But the zero-cost LICENSE test is NOT passed: every terms-of-use URL candidate serves a JavaScript SPA shell (127 KB of markup, ~12 KB navigation-only text) or a redirect landing page with no terms text to a non-browser client. Per PLAN 4.1 item 3 and the lane honesty rule, terms that cannot be captured cannot be judged, so the verdict is EXCLUDED_LICENSE_UNPROVEN, not CANDIDATE. The downloaded files remain primary audit evidence for items 7/10 (distributions, NAV reconciliation) but cannot ground an accepted-source claim on their own; owner may separately authorize browser-based terms capture.
sources.role: issuer-official daily NAV, premium/discount and cash-distribution records

sources.identity: FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis) fredgraph.csv direct graph export, e.g. https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=DFF
sources.rationale: No-account, no-payment access verified in-session (full-history CSV served to a single polite GET; curl HTTP/2 stalls at the host edge while python-urllib succeeds - recorded in the download log). Terms text captured in full (digest recorded). CANDIDATE is conditional and narrow: (a) only series explicitly marked 'Public Domain: Citation Requested' (DFF verified; SOFR to be verified at admission); (b) citation and copyright notices kept; (c) refresh policy must be on-demand single-series downloads in the manner of the site's own download button, NOT scheduled robots-style re-fetching, because automated extraction without the FRED API (whose terms of use and API key require an account - excluded elsewhere) is prohibited by the captured text. This automation-cadence ambiguity is recorded rather than resolved; final admission is the A3/A7 call under PLAN 4.1 item 3.
sources.role: cash-rate daily series (DFF/SOFR) for explicit cash yield
sources.terms_excerpt: 'FRED provides data and data services to the public for non-commercial, educational, and personal uses subject to a few prohibitions.' ... 'You are free to access and use FRED at no cost' ... series DFF page marks 'Public Domain: Citation Requested' ... but the terms also prohibit: 'use of any data mining, mirroring, robots, scraping, or similar data-gathering or extraction methods except as expressly allowed by the terms of use applicable to the FRED API' and require attribution ('be sure to mention FRED as the service from which you retrieved the data and keep any copyright notices').

sources.identity: Yahoo Finance public chart JSON API (query1/query2.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/<SYMBOL>)
sources.rationale: The captured Yahoo Terms of Service grant only a personal, revocable license to use the service; they do not authorize redistribution, local caching as a research dataset, or use as a load-bearing research input. Yahoo is therefore recorded as DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: at most an independent cross-check per PLAN 4.1 item 14, never an accepted source. Additionally, access is flaky for non-browser clients: repeated HTTP 429 responses were observed before a successful 200 in-session.
